P.text: In GTELaunchpadV2Pair._update(), when timeElapsed == 0, totalLaunchpadFees is subtracted from reserves but the tokens are not actually removed from the contract, because _distributeLaunchpadFees() is only called if timeElapsed > 0.
P.evidence_quote: Within `GTELaunchpadV2Pair._update()`, if `timeElapsed == 0`, totalLaunchpadFees will be subtracted from reserves but the tokens will not actually be removed from the contract.

I.text: Reserve accounting should match actual token balances so that amountIn computed as balance.sub(reserve) reflects tokens actually sent to the contract.
I.evidence_quote: This results in a critical vulnerability in both the mint and swap functions where `amountIn` is calculated as `balance.sub(reserve)`.

V.text: After accruing launchpad fees, a malicious user could repeatedly call mint or swap and be credited with an amount they did not send, draining the pair.
V.evidence_quote: After accruing some launchpad fees, a malicious user could repeatedly call mint or swap and be credited with an amount that they did not send to the contract.
